subject.title: fix(gateway): isolate wizard exits from shared process

question: Should `wizard.start.installDaemon` become a supported generated Gateway API that lets remote clients explicitly own daemon-installation policy?
rationale: The lifecycle fix is bounded, but exposing this optional RPC parameter changes the long-term client contract and operational ownership boundary rather than merely repairing internal exit handling.

options.title: Accept the explicit client policy
options.body: Approve `installDaemon` as the supported RPC contract, require exact-head merge-result proof, and document the omission/default behavior through generated protocol compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep daemon policy Gateway-owned
options.body: Remove the new request parameter and preserve existing onboarding defaults while landing only the non-exiting runtime and cancellation-settlement fixes.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Defer the PR until Gateway and onboarding owners define the supported daemon-installation ownership model for external clients.

recommendation.title: Accept the explicit client policy
recommendation.body: Approve `installDaemon` as the supported RPC contract, require exact-head merge-result proof, and document the omission/default behavior through generated protocol compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit trail links CassieMei to the lifecycle and protocol implementation, though current-main feature ownership needs maintainer confirmation.
